outputs.explanation: This is a sequence conservation logo showing amino acid frequency distributions across 120 proteins, not a plot of averaged experimental measurements requiring individual data points.
Bar/mean plot with error bars (mean ± SEM) also shows individual gray dots for each biological replicate, as stated in the caption and visible in the panel.
Microscopy images, not a quantitative averaged plot.
Mean ± SEM plot displays individual yellow dots representing individual cells, as described in the caption and visible in the panel.
Mean ± SEM plot displays individual blue open-circle dots representing individual cells, as described in the caption and visible in the panel.
Super-resolution PALM images of representative cells, not an averaged quantitative plot.
Mean ± SEM plot of number of clusters per cell shows individual gray dots for individual cells.
Mean ± SEM plot of cluster sizes shows individual gray dots for individual clusters.
Mean ± SEM plot of molecule percentage into clusters shows individual gray dots for individual cells.
